description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension. Date key: Decision Date (join qua Inspection Team)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN violation_record ON violation_record.violation_record_id = violation_record_behavior.violation_record_id AND violation_record.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD' AND violation_record.inspection_team_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN inspection_team ON inspection_team.inspection_team_id = violation_record.inspection_team_id AND inspection_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_INSPECTION_TEAM' → LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = inspection_team.decision_dt AND inspection_team.ds_rcrd_isrt_dt = :etl_date
